The Entity Administrator manages which users can act in JustGrants for the applicant.
The full application is submitted in JustGrants by a second deadline; a submitted application may be recalled, edited and resubmitted before that deadline.

A late application is considered only for a documented technical failure of a government system, reported to the agency within 24 hours of the relevant deadline; failure to register in time is not accepted as a reason.

The questionnaire asks whether any federal grant-making agency has designated the applicant "high risk".
OJP reviews applicant risk under 2 C.F.R. 200.206 - financial stability, management systems, performance history, audit reports and ability to comply.
For awards exceeding $250,000, OJP reviews responsibility and qualification information in SAM.gov.
The Disclosure of Lobbying Activities (SF-LLL) is required if the applicant has paid or will pay for lobbying and the award exceeds $100,000.
Required documents include Certified Standard Assurances and the Certifications Regarding Lobbying; Debarment, Suspension and Other Responsibility Matters; and Drug-Free Workplace Requirements.
